subject.why: The pink envelope, wax seal with heart detail, and tucked flower are all clearly depicted and recognisable at a glance.

category.why: The envelope floats in mid-air at a slight tilt over a vibrant gradient background with subtle repeated heart motifs.

clean.why: There are no letters, text, UI elements, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with generous margins on all sides and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: The bright warm yellow background provides excellent contrast and saturation against the pink envelope and red seal.

detail.why: The geometry is clean and chunky with no noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style perfectly with soft rounded bevels, smooth satin materials, and clean 3D rendering.
